issue.title: Dynamically inject harness-listed skills into agent prompt frontmatter for always-on activation

llm_context.input_title: Dynamically inject harness-listed skills into agent prompt frontmatter for always-on activation
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: Skills declared in a harness configuration's `skills:` list are uploaded to the sandbox and listed at runtime, but models frequently fail to invoke them via the Skill tool. The feature request proposes dynamically injecting these harness-listed skill names into the agent prompt's YAML frontmatter `skills:` section at runtime to guarantee always-on activation.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: Agent prompt definitions (such as markdown files with YAML frontmatter like `agents/triage.md`) declare active skills in their frontmatter. When harness files specify custom skills, the runtime loads them into the sandbox environment but does not bridge the harness skill declarations into the agent prompt's frontmatter, causing the model to miss them.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect harness skill loading and agent prompt construction
step_by_step_plan.description: Examine internal/fetchsvc/service.go to locate where harness configurations and skill lists are retrieved, and how agent prompts with YAML frontmatter are constructed.

step_by_step_plan.title: Implement dynamic skill injection into prompt frontmatter
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the service logic in internal/fetchsvc/service.go so that skills declared in the harness configuration's `skills:` list are dynamically injected into the agent prompt's YAML frontmatter `skills:` section at runtime.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add regression test covering runtime skill injection
step_by_step_plan.description: Add or update test cases in internal/config/config_test.go or internal/harness/lint_test.go to verify that harness-declared skills are correctly parsed and injected into the agent prompt frontmatter.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run test suite to verify the changes
step_by_step_plan.description: Execute the package tests to confirm that dynamic skill injection works as expected without causing regressions.
